name: Ark
overview: Ark is a male figure identified as the son of Canaan and belonging to the Arkite tribe. His mention is brief in Scripture, with no additional notes or elaboration on his life or deeds. His primary distinction is his lineage as a descendant of Canaan, situating him within the post-Flood genealogical records.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Ark' is recorded as a proper name in Genesis 10:17. There is no specific meaning or divine origin attributed to the name in the biblical text, and it is presented simply as a personal identifier.
familyAndRelationships: Ark is identified as the son of Canaan, linking him directly to the Canaanite line. Beyond this paternal relationship, Scripture does not provide further details about his family or descendants.
scriptureSignificance: Ark's significance lies in his role within the genealogical framework of Genesis 10, which traces the descendants of Noah's sons after the Flood. As a son of Canaan, Ark represents a branch of the Canaanite lineage, which later holds theological and historical importance in the biblical narrative. His mention helps to establish the broader ethnological context of the nations descended from Noah.
